name: Cinelab
description: Cinelab is inviting first-year students to be a part of our creative team. If you see stories in frames, experiment with perspectives, or simply love creating visual content, this is your chance to showcase your skills.

audition.process:
AUDITION CATEGORIES

Participants can choose ONE of the following categories:

1. Photography
Submit one original photograph based on the given theme/prompt

2. Photography with Editing
Submit
The original photograph
The edited/final version
Editing may include colour grading, retouching, exposure adjustments, composition, etc.

3. Videography
Submit one original video based on the given theme/prompt.
Duration: 30–90 seconds.

4. Videography with Editing
Submit
Original/raw footage
Final edited video
Participants may use editing techniques such as cuts, transitions, colour grading, sound design, text, and music.

AUDITION PROCESS

Step 1 — Choose your category
Select only ONE category from the four available options.

Step 2 — Create your submission
Create your work according to the given theme/prompt and category requirements.

Step 3 — Upload your work
Upload your submission to Google Drive and ensure that the file is accessible through the submitted link.

Step 4 — Submit the form
Fill in the audition form with your details and paste the Google Drive link to your submission.

Step 5 — Evaluation
Submissions will be evaluated by the Cinelab team based on creativity, composition, storytelling, originality and technical execution.

Step 6 — Selection
Shortlisted participants will be contacted by the Cinelab team regarding the next stage of the selection process.

RULES & REGULATIONS

1.Each participant can register for only ONE category.

2.Only ONE submission is permitted per participant.

3.All submitted work must be original and created by the participant.

4.Stock photographs, stock footage, plagiarised work or work created by another person will not be accepted.

5.AI-generated images/videos are not permitted. Regular photo and video editing software may be used where applicable.

6.For edited categories, participants must submit both the original/raw file and the final edited version.

7.Videography submissions must be between 30 and 90 seconds.

8.Photography submissions must be in JPG or PNG format.

9.Video submissions must be in MP4 format.

10.All files must be uploaded to Google Drive with link access set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

11.Participants are responsible for checking that their submitted links work before submitting the form.

12.Submissions received after the deadline may not be considered.

1. The 4 Audition Rounds :

📋 Follow instructions.

🤝 Respect all participants and the panel.
🏆 The panel's decision is final.

name: Developer Club
description: Our coding community is focused on helping students learn, create, and grow together. We provide a collaborative environment where beginners can build strong programming and technical skills through hands-on sessions, projects, and practical activities. Members explore areas such as web development, software development, problem-solving, and emerging technologies while gaining experience by working on real-world challenges. We also encourage students to participate in hackathons, competitions, and technical events to apply their knowledge and build confidence. Through teamwork, peer learning, and knowledge sharing, our goal is to create a community where students can continuously improve, turn ideas into meaningful solutions, and prepare themselves for future opportunities.

audition.process:
🔵 Round 1 — Ouroboros
1. 30–40 questions are given in one continuous sequence.
2. Checkpoints are placed at intervals.
3. Answer correctly to move forward to the next question/checkpoint.
4. First mistake: You go back to the nearest checkpoint you have already cleared.
5. Second mistake: The entire run resets, and you start again from the beginning.
6. The name Ouroboros represents the loop-back system, where mistakes send you toward the start.

🟢 Round 2 — Block Game
1. Understand the Goal – Know what you need to complete.
2. Build the Solution – Drag and connect blocks in the correct order.
3. Plan Carefully – Commands run in sequence, so order matters.
4. Use Available Blocks – Follow the given blocks and their limits.
5. Test & Fix – Run your program and correct mistakes.
6. Complete the Level – Solve the challenge to unlock the next level.
7. Work Independently – No outside help unless it is specifically allowed.

🟡 Round 3 — Royal Rumble
1. Join the Game – Enter your name and join.
2. Earn Coins – Answer MCQs correctly to earn coins.
3. Attack Players – Use your coins to attack other players.
4. Defend Yourself – Answer the defense question correctly to block an attack.
5. 3 Lives – Every player starts with 3 lives.
6. Lose a Life – A failed defense costs 1 life.
7. Elimination – Losing all 3 lives eliminates you.
8. Final Winner – The last player remaining wins.

name: Bec Robotics
description:
BEC Robotics & Drone Club is a student-driven technical community focused on robotics, automation, drones, and emerging technologies.
We provide members with hands-on learning through projects, workshops, challenges, and competitions.
Members get opportunities to work with electronics, microcontrollers, sensors, programming, mechanical systems, and robotics platforms.
The club encourages students to move beyond theory and build real, working systems.
From beginners taking their first step into robotics to experienced builders, everyone gets a platform to learn and contribute.
Our goal is to build a strong technical community that learns, builds, competes, and innovates together

audition.process:
## Audition Rules

### **Round 1 — Technical Quiz**

1. The first round will be a **technical quiz**.
2. Questions will cover **basic robotics, electronics, programming, mechanical concepts, logical reasoning, and general technical knowledge**.
3. The quiz will be conducted individually.
4. Candidates must complete the quiz within the given time.
5. **No external assistance** is allowed.
6. Mobile phones, internet searches, AI tools, and discussion with other candidates are not permitted.
7. Candidates meeting the required criteria will be **shortlisted for Round 2**.
8. The quiz score will be considered in the overall selection process.

### **Round 2 — Personal Interview**

1. Only candidates shortlisted from Round 1 will attend the interview.
2. The interview will assess:
   - **Technical interest and basic knowledge**
   - **Problem-solving approach**
   - **Interest in robotics and technology**
   - **Willingness to learn**
   - **Teamwork and communication**
   - **Commitment to club activities**
3. Candidates may be asked about their **projects, previous experience, technical interests, or areas they want to learn**.
4. Previous robotics experience is **not mandatory**.
5. Candidates should answer honestly and demonstrate their own understanding.
6. Final selection will be based on the **overall performance in both rounds**.

- An **expression test** will be conducted.

- **Previous acting experience is not required**.

- Final selection will be made by the **audition panel**.
